title: Buttery German Potato Dumplings
description: A classic German dish featuring boiled dumplings smothered in a rich butter sauce.
instructions: Boil a large pot of salted water and cook the potatoes until they're tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash them in a large bowl.
Add the flour to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it's smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each one into a ball.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 10-12 minutes.
While the dumplings are cooking, melt the butter in a large skillet.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and toss them in the butter until they're well-coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the dumplings hot, smothered in the butter sauce.
